name: Nagi
source:
Species: Invisible Man
Good at studying and kind to everyone. In contrast to his cute appearance, he is pretty honest and has self control. But sometimes, he will reveal a gloomy look at a glance.

"Can I...... stay in your memories?"

[Edited from [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/002/en]Official site[/url]]
